newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stock exchange suspends Ades.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stock exchange suspends Ades.

text.p: The Jakarta stock exchange suspended trading in shares of Indonesian mineral water producer PT Ades Alfindo on Monday following a sudden sharp rise in the small stock's share price, an exchange official said.
"The exchange suspend trading in Ades a few minutes after the second session started as its share price went up about 28 percent," an official who declined to be identified said.
He said the exchange had contacted the firm to ask it to provide information about the sudden movement and any possible corporate action which could affect trading.
The official also said the exchange might resume the trading later in the day if it found no irregularities.
Ades Alfindo was up 450 rupiah, or 28.13 percent, at 2,050 rupiah, with around 1.1 million shares traded before it was suspended at around 06.40 GMT.
